steps.title: Ask a question
steps.question: What does car parking cost for the first 2 hours on a weekday?
steps.hint: A miss: Weir searches the documents, asks a model and caches the answer.

steps.title: Reword it
steps.question: Weekday car parking cost for the first 2 hours?
steps.hint: Same meaning, same details: a cache hit at near-zero cost.

steps.title: A look-alike
steps.question: What does car parking cost for the first 2 hours on a weekend?
steps.hint: Almost the same words, a different day: the guard refuses the cached weekday price (the weekend price is ₹60, not ₹40).

steps.title: An easy question
steps.question: What is the first consultation fee at the Orthopedics OPD?
steps.hint: Short and answered by one document: the small, cheaper model.

steps.title: A hard question
steps.question: What colour attendant pass does a parent staying with a child in the pediatric ward get, and what are the evening visiting hours there?
steps.hint: Two questions in one: the large model.
